title: Lowe's Product Scraper Input
description: Find Lowe's products by keyword, category, item ID, or URL, then read live price, stock, specs, and store details from Lowe's product pages.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search for (mode=search). Each query adds its own discovery results.

itemIds.title: Item IDs or product URLs
itemIds.description: Lowe's item numbers (for example 5013207487) or /pd/ product URLs. Used by mode=productDetails.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Lowe's product, search, or /pl/ category URLs. Used by mode=byUrl, and category URLs are also accepted by mode=byCategory.

storeId.title: Store number
storeId.description: Four-digit Lowe's store number used for price and stock context. Default 0208 (La Quinta, CA).

zipCode.title: ZIP code
zipCode.description: Five-digit ZIP code used with the store number for price and stock context. Default 92253.

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: How to order the products found in this run.

inStockOnly.title: In-stock only
inStockOnly.description: Only emit products with at least one fulfilment method available.

onSaleOnly.title: On-sale only
onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products with a current was/sale price.

onShelfOnly.title: On shelf at the store only
onShelfOnly.description: Only emit products with pickup quantity above zero at the selected store.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)
minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this value. Products without a price are skipped when a price filter is set.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this value. Products without a price are skipped when a price filter is set.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Drop products rated below this value. Products without a rating are skipped when this filter is set.

includeDetails.title: Include specification details
includeDetails.description: Add description, bullets, specifications, UPC, dimensions, warranty, and manuals to each product.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to emit. Discovery may return fewer candidates than this.
